summary.text: Lowell Reynolds is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 7th District, a music producer and audio engineer who is also a third-year law student. His campaign materials emphasize constitutional separation of powers, independence from both major parties, and support for small businesses and working families.

paragraphs.text: Reynolds attended Brown County High School and, per Ballotpedia, earned an associate degree from Indiana University's Jacobs School of Music in 2002 and a bachelor's degree in business from Indiana University East's School of Business and Economics in 2019.
He says he has worked in the music industry for more than 20 years as a producer and audio engineer, and that his work earned him a Grammy statuette. He describes himself as a husband and father.
Reynolds has not held elected office.
